protections.name: ABI selector (ld()/il() in s.h.e.l.l.S)
protections.bypass: Stripping lib/arm* (make_dump_build.py) forces a pure x86_64 process that extracts ijm_lib/x86_64/libexec.so natively. On armeabi-v7a pins the process is FULL ARM (/system/bin/arm/app_process) and the x86 libexec is rejected (EM_386 vs EM_ARM).

protections.name: Account / VIP / device-bind (LoginAty, DeviceManageAty)
protections.bypass: Out of scope. Entitlements live on portal hosts.

protections.name: Content-integrity gate (signed.bin/ed25519 over APK)
protections.bypass: Keeping v1 META-INF certs and transplanting the original <sigs> into packages.xml both FAIL: the check is content-level and runs BEFORE decryption. Only the byte-exact original decrypts.

protections.name: Anti-tamper death ladder: raw-syscall kill/exit, int3, ud2, SIGSEGV
protections.bypass: unpack/trace_guard.c: ptrace supervisor rewrites kill/tgkill/exit/exit_group syscalls to getpid, swallows int3 traps, skips ud2 (RIP+2), suppresses SIGABRT; relaying SIGSEGV is fatal (deliberate, not ART null-checks).

protections.name: PTRACE_TRACEME probe + watchdog children
protections.bypass: Guard rewrites PTRACE_TRACEME to sched_yield (returns 0 = fake success); TRACEFORK/TRACECLONE follows watchdogs. The memdump is out-of-process and undetectable.
